run_config.input_preprocessing: upstream utils.get_transform: bicubic squash to 518x518 + center crop + CLIP mean/std
run_config.anomaly_map: upstream (sim[...,1]+1-sim[...,0])/2 at 518x518 + gaussian sigma 4, then cv2 INTER_LINEAR to native size; float32; no min-max
run_config.checkpoint_source_training_data: MVTec AD, trained by the authors (upstream train.sh trains this folder with --dataset mvtec); nothing fitted on VisA
run_config.calibration_usage: 20 normal images for the OK/NG threshold only
run_config.timing_scope: per image predict_one: read + preprocess + CLIP forward + score + map + gaussian + resize to native, with cuda synchronize; excludes model loading, map file writing, metric evaluation

calibration_usage: 20 normal images for threshold only; no training or reference bank

resources.peak_scope: calibration + test predict_one calls, after warm-up; model stays resident and is included
resources.timing_includes: predict_one call and optional device synchronization
resources.timing_excludes: bank construction, calibration, map file writing, metric evaluation
